name: infocyph/foundation
description: Performance-first application foundation for the Infocyph PHP ecosystem.

suggest.infocyph/cachelayer: Adds cache stores, locks, counters, and CacheLayer-backed authentication state.
suggest.infocyph/dblayer: Adds database services, persistence, migrations, and database-backed authentication.
suggest.infocyph/epicrypt: Adds cryptography, secrets, password, token, and key security services.
suggest.infocyph/omnibus: Adds events, messages, queues, retries, workflows, and scheduled-message dispatch.
suggest.infocyph/otp: Adds OTP-backed multi-factor authentication with replay-safe state integration.
suggest.infocyph/pathwise: Adds filesystem, storage, upload, download, archive, and sync capabilities.
suggest.infocyph/reqshield: Adds request, command, configuration, and database validation services.
suggest.infocyph/talkingbytes: Adds HTTP, email, webhook, and gRPC communication services.
